install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export ENCORE_INSTALL="$HOME/.encore"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export ENCORE_INSTALL="$HOME/.encore"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$ENCORE_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$ENCORE_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; if ! command -v encore >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.encore/bin/encore" ]; then sh install_encore.sh; fi; go mod download && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile
